notes.title: Minagoroshi On Sale Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Order Minagoroshi now and get 10% off during launch week!![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1034940/Higurashi_When_They_Cry_Hou__Ch7_Minagoroshi/

At long last, you can enjoy the sixth chapter of this exciting Visual Novel that spawned the highly-acclaimed Higurashi anime and manga series on Steam for the very first time! With updated sprites and other visuals, fans won't want to miss this new release!

In this chapter, Minagoroshi, Keiichi manages to make the choice that would avert the tragedies of Watanagashi and Meakashi. With this revelation that Keiichi and the others are beginning to learn from the events of prior chapters, Rika finally gains hope that there might be a way to end this relentless cycle. Yet those hopes are soon stifled with the arrival of Houjou Teppei, Satoko's abusive uncle. Can the club members avert the tragedy of Tatarigoroshi this time around? Will a different chain of events finally reveal the mastermind behind the tragedies of Hinamizawa? And also... who is the mysterious figure Rika seems to be talking to this time around?

The Answer Arcs continue, and revelations await. So keep your eyes open and don't miss out!

Don't forget to check out our 07th Expansion page either:

http://www.mangagamer.org/07thExpansion/

Help spread the word on twitter with #Higurashi and introduce new fans to this remastered version of such a great series from 07th Expansion!

notes.title: The House in Fata Morgana Version 1.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone. As some of you may have heard, The House in Fata Morgana was released on the 3DS in Japan by FuRyu a couple days ago. For this new edition of the game, Novectacle completely remade the Maid’s sprites, and we’re bringing those updated graphics to the PC release for you today. Here’s a quick sample of how the new sprites look compared to the original.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22491261/e988f5b9f4af3e10420b4b8be6c2fa46f2fca9b6.jpg[/img]
Original

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22491261/d9473d4e1a66771456475bae9c54624ee0b632dd.jpg[/img]
Update

[b]NOTE:[/b] If you would like to retain the original sprites, you can revert to version 1.1 by right clicking on "The House in Fata Morgana" in your Steam client -> Properties -> Betas -> select "v1.1" from the dropdown box.

notes.title: The House in Fata Morgana Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone. We've got a little surprise for you today to celebrate the ongoing summer sale. Our friends at Novectacle have been hard at work behind the scenes polishing and enhancing [i]The House in Fata Morgana[/i], and we're bringing you the first fruits of their ongoing efforts today.

The update includes minor script modifications, adjustments to Mell's and Pauline's sprites, and a complete overhaul of the sound effects. More than 75% of the game's SFX have been replaced with higher quality effects, and the total number of unique SFX has been increased almost 2.5x, giving the game a much richer, more immersive soundscape.

The version 1.1 update is live on both Steam and the MangaGamer website right now.

notes.title: The House in Fata Morgana Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]The House in Fata Morgana is coming on May 13th!![/h1]

Obsession. Sadism. Avarice. Zealotry. Death. A recipe for horror heaped upon tragedy. And the paving stones of the road to the House in Fata Morgana. But is it a road to revenge and damnation? Or redemption and salvation?

This exquisite gothic suspense will leave readers questioning human nature, the merits of vengeance versus forgiveness, and the meaning of struggles against adversity. With 65 different musical tracks by five composers and a beautiful gothic art style, The House in Fata Morgana breathes life into its merciless tales of trials and tribulations--tales which come together to create a fresco for all readers to enjoy.

Visit our promotional page for more details on packages and availability:
http://mangagamer.org/fatamorgana/
